This is clay code for the release 5 on github for official version called 0.14.
Here is the link: "https://github.com/nicbarker/clay/releases/tag/v0.14"

In this version they did not yet have layoutElementsHashMapFreeList and so 
the clay internal hash table array was overflowing from the generated FAKE ids 
that our ui lib was producing based on addresses.

For that reason we had to switch for a newer version of clay. This here was 
written on July 30th 2026, at this time the laterst version of clay 
is the one from release 5 (0.14), so no freeing of the hash table on the side 
of clay. But the activally developed source code for clay does have that now.
The version is stil called 0.14 in its source code, but thats now the same 0.14 as
from the release.
